goal.name: Candidate Recruitment
goal.description: How candidates move from inbound application through screening, client submission and interviews to offer and placement

source.note: Synthetic sample built from the customer event list; each raw UI event is listed under the sub-step (canonical_subtypes[].events) it belongs to.

tasks.name: Review Inbound Email
tasks.description: The consultant opens the recruitment inbox, reads a new application or referral email and marks it processed so it is not picked up twice.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Every candidate enters through the shared inbox; the consultant triages the email, confirms it is a real application and flips its status from Unprocessed to Processed.

canonical_subtypes.name: Process from inbox menu
canonical_subtypes.description: Opened from the left menu and processed in place.
events: Email Inbox (From Menu) - Click - Email Received
Process Email - Click - Email Received
Confirm - Click - Process Email - Email Received
Process Status: Processed - Click - Email Received
OK - Click - Process Status - Email Received

canonical_subtypes.name: Process in fullscreen inbox
canonical_subtypes.description: Worked in the fullscreen inbox, stepping back through earlier emails.
events: Email Inbox (Fullscreen) - Click - Email Received
Previous - Click - Process Email - Email Received
Process Email - Click - Email Received
Confirm - Click - Process Email - Email Received

canonical_subtypes.name: Leave unprocessed
canonical_subtypes.description: Checked the sent folder, cancelled processing and left the email Unprocessed for follow-up.
events: Sent Folder - Click - Email Received
Cancel - Click - Process Email - Email Received
Process Status: Unprocessed - Click - Email Received

tasks.name: Create Candidate Profile
tasks.description: A candidate record is created in the ATS and the personal contact details (mobile, landline, email, LinkedIn, website) are filled in from the CV and email.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Contact details are mandatory (REQ) before a candidate can be shortlisted, so the consultant copies them from the application into the Personal tab.

canonical_subtypes.name: Add core contact details
canonical_subtypes.description: Mobile number and email address entered.
events: Add Contact Details (REQ) - Click - Personal - Candidate
Add Mobile Number - Click - Contact Details - Personal - Candidate
Email Address
Email - Candidate Header
Mobile - Candidate Header

canonical_subtypes.name: Add social and web links
canonical_subtypes.description: LinkedIn profile and personal URL added.
events: Add LinkedIn - Click - Contact Details - Personal - Candidate
Add URL - Click - Contact Details - Personal - Candidate
Linkedin - Candidate Header
Expand - Click - Candidate Header

canonical_subtypes.name: Add other numbers
canonical_subtypes.description: Landline or other contact method added.
events: Add Other - Click - Contact Details - Personal - Candidate
Landline - Candidate Header

tasks.name: Upload CV & Documents
tasks.description: The CV and any supporting documents (certificates, portfolios) are attached to the candidate record.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: A document is required (REQ) on the candidate; the CV becomes the file sent to clients later.

canonical_subtypes.name: Upload CV
canonical_subtypes.description: CV uploaded and shown in the candidate header.
events: Add Document (REQ) - Click - Candidate
Upload - Click - Add Document - Candidate
CV - Candidate Header

canonical_subtypes.name: Cancel and retry upload
canonical_subtypes.description: Upload cancelled (wrong file) and redone.
events: Add Document (REQ) - Click - Candidate
Cancel - Click - Add Document - Candidate
Upload - Click - Add Document - Candidate

tasks.name: Add Qualifications
tasks.description: Degrees, certifications and licences from the CV are entered as structured qualifications on the candidate.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Structured qualifications let consultants search and match candidates to job requirements.

canonical_subtypes.name: Create qualification
canonical_subtypes.description: Qualification created and saved.
events: Create - Click - Qualifications - Candidate

canonical_subtypes.name: Abandon entry
canonical_subtypes.description: Qualification form opened then cancelled.
events: Cancel - Click - Qualifications - Candidate

tasks.name: Shortlist Candidate
tasks.description: The candidate is moved to the Shortlist stage on the job after a fit check against the role.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Changing stage is required (REQ) to progress the candidate on the job pipeline.

canonical_subtypes.name: Move to Shortlist
canonical_subtypes.description: Stage changed to Shortlist from the job.
events: Change Stage (REQ) - Click - Jobs
Short list - Click - Change Stage - Jobs

tasks.name: Add to Candidate Review
tasks.description: The shortlisted candidate is added to the internal Candidate Review list and the reviewer is emailed.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: A second consultant reviews shortlisted candidates before anything is sent to the client.

canonical_subtypes.name: Add via activity
canonical_subtypes.description: Added through Add Activity on the candidate.
events: Add to Candidate Review - Click - Add Activity - Candidate
Select Candidate - Click - Candidate Review

canonical_subtypes.name: Add and email reviewer
canonical_subtypes.description: Added and the reviewer notified by email.
events: Select Candidate - Click - Candidate Review
Email - Click - Candidate Review

tasks.name: Configure Job Details
tasks.description: Commercial and compliance details are set on the job: retainer fee and, for Singapore roles, the government occupation tag.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Fee and occupation tags must be on the job before the first CV is submitted to the client.

canonical_subtypes.name: Add retainer fee
canonical_subtypes.description: New retainer fee added to the job.
events: Retainer Fee - Add New Fee - Jobs

canonical_subtypes.name: Tag occupation (Singapore)
canonical_subtypes.description: Government occupation tag applied.
events: Government Occupation Tag - Click - Jobs - Singapore

tasks.name: Send CV to Client
tasks.description: The candidate is moved to Send CV and an email with the CV is composed to the client contact.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Submitting the CV is the hand-off to the client; the stage change and email are logged together.

canonical_subtypes.name: Send from job pipeline
canonical_subtypes.description: Stage set to Send CV and email created from the job.
events: Send CV - Click - Change Stage - Jobs
Create Email - Send CV - Jobs

canonical_subtypes.name: Send from client contact
canonical_subtypes.description: Email created from the Client Contact Library.
events: Create Email - Click - Client Contact Library

tasks.name: Schedule Interview
tasks.description: An interview (Candidate IV) is created and the meeting type chosen: video call, phone call or face to face.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Interviews are logged as Candidate IV records so the client, candidate and consultant share one schedule.

canonical_subtypes.name: Video call
canonical_subtypes.description: Video interview scheduled.
events: TEST Create - Candidate IV - Meeting Type?
Video Call - Click - Meeting type - Add Candidate IV

canonical_subtypes.name: Phone call
canonical_subtypes.description: Phone screen scheduled.
events: TEST Create - Candidate IV - Meeting Type?
Phone Call - click - Meeting Type - Add Candidate IV

canonical_subtypes.name: Face to face
canonical_subtypes.description: In-person interview scheduled.
events: TEST Create - Candidate IV - Meeting Type?
Face to face - Click - Meeting Type - Add Candidate IV

tasks.name: Log Client Activity
tasks.description: Calls and meetings with the hiring manager about the candidate are logged on the client contact.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Activity (REQ) on the client record keeps the account history complete for billing and BD.

canonical_subtypes.name: Client call
canonical_subtypes.description: Feedback call with the hiring manager logged.
events: Add Activity (REQ) - Client Contacts - summary tab
Add Client Call - Click - Client Contacts

canonical_subtypes.name: Client meeting
canonical_subtypes.description: Meeting with the client logged.
events: Add Client Meeting - Click - Client Contacts
Client Meeting - Click - Add Activity

canonical_subtypes.name: BD call / consultant meeting
canonical_subtypes.description: Business-development call or internal meeting logged.
events: Add BD Call - Click - Client Contacts
Add Meeting with Consultant - Add Activity

tasks.name: Advance Interview Round
tasks.description: After client feedback the candidate is moved to the next interview round.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Each round is a stage on the job so pipeline reports show where candidates sit.

canonical_subtypes.name: 1st round
canonical_subtypes.description: Moved to 1st Round.
events: 1st Round - Click - Change Stage - Jobs

canonical_subtypes.name: 2nd round
canonical_subtypes.description: Moved to 2nd Round.
events: 2nd Round - Click - Change Stage - Jobs

canonical_subtypes.name: Additional round
canonical_subtypes.description: Extra round requested by the client.
events: Additional Round - Click - Change Stage - Jobs

tasks.name: Email Candidate
tasks.description: The consultant emails the candidate with interview details, feedback or outcome.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Candidates are kept informed at each step; emails are sent from the candidate record so they are logged.

canonical_subtypes.name: Email from candidate record
canonical_subtypes.description: Email composed and sent from the candidate.
events: Email Candidate - Click - Candidate
Send Email - Click - Email Candidate

tasks.name: Record Salary Details
tasks.description: Expected and offered salary is recorded: total package value and its breakdown (base, bonus, allowances).
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Package details drive the offer letter and the placement fee calculation.

canonical_subtypes.name: Total package
canonical_subtypes.description: Total package value entered.
events: Salary Details - Click - Career - Candidate
Total Package Value - Type - Edit Salary Details - Candidate

canonical_subtypes.name: Package breakdown
canonical_subtypes.description: Breakdown of package components entered.
events: Salary Details - Click - Career - Candidate
Package Breakdown - Type - Edit Salary Details - Candidate

tasks.name: Make Offer
tasks.description: The candidate is moved to the Offer stage once the client confirms they want to hire.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: The Offer stage triggers offer paperwork and pauses other submissions for the candidate.

canonical_subtypes.name: Move to Offer
canonical_subtypes.description: Stage changed to Offer.
events: Offer - Click - Change Stage - Jobs

tasks.name: Place Candidate
tasks.description: The accepted offer is recorded as a placement, closing the candidate on the job and starting invoicing.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Placement is the successful end of the process and the point the fee becomes billable.

canonical_subtypes.name: Move to Placed
canonical_subtypes.description: Stage changed to Place.
events: Place - Click - Change Stage - Jobs

tasks.name: Reject Candidate
tasks.description: The candidate is rejected from the job, with a confirmation step to avoid accidental rejections.
tasks.canonical_reasoning: Rejections end the candidate on this job; the Are you sure? prompt is often backed out of and retried.

canonical_subtypes.name: Reject and confirm
canonical_subtypes.description: Rejected and confirmed.
events: Reject - Click - Jobs
OK - Click - Are you sure? - Jobs

canonical_subtypes.name: Back out then reject
canonical_subtypes.description: Went back from the confirmation, then rejected.
events: Reject - Click - Jobs
Go Back - Click - Are you sure? - Jobs
OK - Click - Are you sure? - Jobs
